# Provenance of the generated files in this directory

`polo.pb.dart` / `polo.pbenum.dart` / `polo.pbjson.dart` and
`remotemessage.pb.dart` / `remotemessage.pbenum.dart` /
`remotemessage.pbjson.dart` are machine-generated by `protoc` +
`protoc-gen-dart` from the `polo.proto` and `remotemessage.proto`
message definitions used by the Android TV Remote protocol (v2).

These `.proto` definitions are not published by Google in source form.
This project obtained them by extracting the compiled
`FileDescriptorProto` embedded in the Python `_pb2.py` modules of the
**androidtvremote2** package (https://pypi.org/project/androidtvremote2/,
source: https://github.com/tronikos/androidtvremote2), licensed under the
**Apache License 2.0** (Copyright the androidtvremote2 authors), and
re-generating Dart bindings from that descriptor with `protoc`. No
Dart-specific code from that project was copied - only the protobuf
message *shape* (field names/numbers/types), which the wire protocol
itself requires to be reproduced byte-for-byte to interoperate.

Do not hand-edit these files. To refresh them, re-extract the descriptor
from a newer `androidtvremote2` release and re-run `protoc` - see
`docs/research/android-google-tv.md` for the exact steps taken.

A copy of the Apache License 2.0 applies to the reproduced message
definitions: http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
